planners.name: opencamlib
build: PY=$(command -v python3.11 || command -v python3.10 || command -v python3.9 || command -v python3); test -x planners/opencamlib/.venv/bin/python || $PY -m venv planners/opencamlib/.venv; planners/opencamlib/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q opencamlib
planners.note: a library of tool placements (drop-cutter, waterline), linked into programs by a small helper of its implementations; its Python wheels need Python 3.11 or earlier

planners.name: camlib
build: PY=$(command -v python3.12 || command -v python3); test -x planners/camlib/.venv/bin/python || $PY -m venv planners/camlib/.venv; planners/camlib/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q 'camlib @ git+https://github.com/stevecad/camlib@78d3074225f9e1896c1b237970ff7394d3d39bd2'
planners.note: built from source at a pinned commit (it needs Rust and Python 3.12 or later); its program is a toolpath, its own typed motion written as it is
